title: Gemini 4 Carbon Explained: Google's Model That Thinks Longer
description: Gemini 4 Carbon is Google's new reasoning model. Learn what it is, what it costs, and how to call it from Python with the google-genai SDK.
summary: Gemini 4 Carbon is Google’s new reasoning model. It became generally available in the Gemini API on November 10, 2026, and it thinks longer than its sibling Argon before it answers.
takeaways: By the end of this tutorial, you’ll understand that: Carbon is Argon with more thinking : same context window, same tools, same price per token.
If you’ve never set up an API key, then check out How to Integrate ChatGPT’s API With Python Projects .
New models, new prices, new agent tools, all the time.
